about_short_description.short_description: Mala'a Technologies is a finance management app that helps manage finances and provides recommendations on finances.

product.name: Mala'a Financial Planner
product.description: A financial planning software that helps users manage their finances by aggregating multiple bank accounts, tracking expenses, monitoring credit levels, and setting financial goals.

product.name: Mala'a Investment Advisory Services
product.description: Automated investment advisory and robo-advisory services that provide users with diversified investment portfolios aligned with their risk tolerance and financial goals.

product.name: Expense Management and Budgeting Tools
product.description: Tools within the app that enable users to categorize, track, and analyze their spending, and apply budgeting rules such as the 50/30/20 rule to manage income and expenses.

product.name: Account Aggregation Service
product.description: A service that securely aggregates financial data from multiple third-party financial institutions into a unified dashboard for user convenience and financial analysis.

identifier.value: Financial Data Privacy and Security Framework

product.name: Financial Data Privacy and Security Framework
product.description: A data privacy and security framework ensuring user data is collected, processed, and stored securely in compliance with Saudi regulations and industry standards.
